edges.reason: _msgSender returns the caller-controlled msg.sender.
Constructor derives the initial owner and initial mint from msg.sender.
transfer passes _msgSender() as the sender to _transfer.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as the spender for the allowance decrease.
approve passes _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
manualswap authorizes execution by comparing _msgSender() to _feeAddrWallet1.
manualsend authorizes execution by comparing _msgSender() to _feeAddrWallet1.
Caller identity flows into the manual authorization require statements.
Miner-influenced block.timestamp gates the cooldown condition.
block.timestamp is passed as the router swap deadline.
block.timestamp is passed as the addLiquidityETH deadline.
sender reflection balance is decremented with SafeMath sub.
tAmount drives the reflection amount arithmetic in _getValues.
amount parameter is validated and forwarded within _transfer.
from address is checked against owner and blacklists.
to address is checked against the pair and blacklists.
balanceOf reads _rOwned[account] for conversion.
_transferStandard reads and writes _rOwned balances.
_reflectFee subtracts the reflection fee from _rTotal.
_reflectFee adds the token fee to _tFeeTotal.
_takeTeam credits the team reflection amount to the contract's _rOwned entry.
sendETHToFee transfers ETH to _feeAddrWallet1.
sendETHToFee transfers ETH to _feeAddrWallet2.
_feeAddr1 tax percentage feeds _getTValues through _getValues.
_feeAddr2 team percentage feeds _getTValues through _getValues.
swapTokensForEth calls the stored router address.
_transfer compares from/to against the stored pair address.
cooldown mapping value is read in the timestamp gate.
_transfer reads and writes the cooldown mapping for the recipient.
_transfer requires that sender and recipient are not blacklisted bots.
_transfer checks fee-exclusion flags before applying taxation and cooldown.
tradingActive must be true for non-owner transfers.
inSwap guard prevents nested automatic swaps inside _transfer.
swapEnabled gates the automatic liquidity conversion block.
cooldownEnabled gates the cooldown enforcement block.
_maxTxAmount bounds the transfer amount when buying from the pair.
owner() returns the stored _owner address.
_owner is compared to the caller in onlyOwner checks.
_transferStandard writes adjusted reflection balances into _rOwned.
_takeTeam adds the team reflection amount to _rOwned[address(this)].
_reflectFee mutates the total reflection supply with subtraction.
_reflectFee accumulates the total fee with addition.
_approve writes the spender allowance into _allowances.
_transfer stores the next allowed timestamp in the cooldown mapping.
setBots marks addresses as bots in the blacklist mapping.
delBot clears the blacklist flag for an address.
openTrading stores the router instance.
openTrading stores the created pair address.
openTrading sets tradingOpen to true.
openTrading enables automatic swaps.
openTrading disables the cooldown feature.
openTrading reduces the maximum transaction amount.
enableTrading sets tradingActive to true.
setCooldownEnabled writes the cooldownEnabled flag.
Constructor assigns the first fee wallet.
Constructor assigns the second fee wallet.
Constructor mints the whole reflection supply to the deployer.
Constructor marks deployer, contract and fee wallets as fee-exempt.
Ownable constructor initializes _owner to the deployer.
renounceOwnership clears the owner address.
_feeAddrWallet1 is the destination of the raw ETH transfer.
_feeAddrWallet2 is the destination of the raw ETH transfer.
Constructor calls _msgSender to resolve the deployer.
Constructor calls owner() during fee-exclusion setup.
transfer invokes the internal _transfer routine.
transferFrom invokes _transfer before decreasing allowance.
transferFrom calls _approve to reduce the spender allowance.
approve calls _approve to write the allowance.
balanceOf calls tokenFromReflection for the conversion.
_transfer delegates the actual balance movement to _tokenTransfer.
_transfer calls balanceOf to size the automatic swap.
_transfer swaps accumulated tokens for ETH when enabled.
_transfer distributes the collected ETH to the fee wallets.
_transfer evaluates the timestamp-based cooldown requirement.
_tokenTransfer forwards execution to _transferStandard.
_transferStandard calls _getValues to derive transfer amounts.
_transferStandard credits the team share via _takeTeam.
_transferStandard reflects the fee via _reflectFee.
swapTokensForEth approves the router before swapping.
swapTokensForEth performs the external router swap.
sendETHToFee sends half of the ETH to the first fee wallet.
sendETHToFee sends half of the ETH to the second fee wallet.
openTrading calls the factory to create the pair.
openTrading adds ETH liquidity through the router.
openTrading approves the pair token for the router.
manualswap triggers a token-to-ETH swap of the contract balance.
manualsend distributes the contract ETH balance.
_getValues calls _getTValues for the token components.
_getValues calls _getRValues for the reflection components.
_getValues fetches the current reflection rate.
_getRate reads supplies from _getCurrentSupply.
tokenFromReflection uses _getRate for the division.
Router swap can return ETH to the contract and re-enter the empty receive hook.
ETH transfer to a fee wallet can execute recipient fallback code during execution.
ETH transfer to the second fee wallet can execute recipient fallback code.
Router liquidity call can invoke the payable receive hook on refunds.
External router call inside the transfer path could re-enter _transfer, though the inSwap guard blocks nested swaps.

normalization_plan.reason: _transfer's from parameter is only meaningful inside the _transfer body.
_transfer's to parameter is only meaningful inside the _transfer body.
_transfer's amount parameter is consumed by the _transfer logic.
contractTokenBalance is a temporary local used solely within _transfer.
sender parameter is only used inside _transferStandard for balance updates.
recipient parameter is only used inside _transferStandard for balance updates.
tAmount parameter is only used inside _transferStandard.
tTeam parameter is only used inside _takeTeam.
tokenAmount parameter is only used inside swapTokensForEth.
amount parameter is only used inside sendETHToFee.
account parameter flows from balanceOf into tokenFromReflection.
